name: Falling for Spritz Flight
description: A sampling of four different spritzes just in time for autumn: Aperol, Elderflower, Pumpkin & Pomegranate.
serverNotes:
🍂 ABOUT: Seasonal flight of four spritzes: Aperol, Elderflower, Pumpkin and Pomegranate. Lets guests taste four aperitivo styles at once.

🍹 PROFILE: Light & bubbly | Bitter orange, floral elderflower, warm pumpkin spice and tart pomegranate | Low to moderate alcohol

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Appetizers and sharing plates: calamari, arancini, Italian Meat & Cheese Board, pizza.

💡 SERVING TIP: Suggest tasting Aperol first and Pumpkin last. Fun for two to share before dinner.

name: The Caprese Martini
description: Gray Whale Gin, basil, tomato, olive brine, cracked black pepper, mozzarella & balsamic pearls.
serverNotes:
🍅 ABOUT: A savory martini built like a caprese salad: Gray Whale Gin, basil, tomato, olive brine and cracked black pepper, garnished with mozzarella and balsamic pearls.

🍸 PROFILE: Savory & spirit-forward | Fresh basil, ripe tomato, briny olive and pepper | Dry, not sweet

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Burrata Caprese, Heirloom Tomato Margherita, Prosciutto Wrapped Mozzarella, antipasto.

💡 SERVING TIP: For dirty-martini fans. Note the mozzarella garnish (dairy) for allergy questions.

name: Pumpkin Margarita
description: Reposado, St. George Spiced Pear, pumpkin spice liqueur, agave, lime, orange, cinnamon rim.
serverNotes:
🎃 ABOUT: Autumn margarita: reposado tequila, St. George Spiced Pear, pumpkin spice liqueur, agave, lime and orange with a cinnamon rim.

🍹 PROFILE: Warm-spiced & citrusy | Pumpkin pie spice, ripe pear, bright lime | Medium sweetness

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roasted Pork Belly, Crispy Pork Meatballs, Berkshire Pork Chop, pizza.

💡 SERVING TIP: A seasonal crowd-pleaser for margarita drinkers.

name: Barrel Aged Sangria
description: Enjoy Red or White. 1/2 Carafe 19, Full Carafe 38
serverNotes: House specialty barrel-aged sangria available in red or white. Aged in oak barrels for smooth, complex flavor. Wine-based with fresh fruit, citrus, and subtle oak notes. Perfect for sharing—order half carafe ($19) or full carafe ($38). Great for groups, celebrations, or warm weather drinking. Pairs beautifully with appetizers, charcuterie, pizza, and lighter Italian fare. Refreshing alternative to wine by the glass. House-made recipe that's become a Via signature. Popular choice for brunch, lunch, or dinner.

name: Wimbledon
description: Vodka, lemon, basil, strawberry, soda water.
serverNotes:
🍓 ABOUT: Light, refreshing vodka highball with lemon, basil, strawberry and soda water.

🍹 PROFILE: Bright & fruity | Fresh strawberry, herbal basil, tart lemon | Bubbly and easy-drinking

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Salads, Burrata Caprese, shrimp, lighter lunch dishes.

💡 SERVING TIP: Good pick for guests who want something light and not too sweet.

name: Blueberry Bombshell
description: Blueberry Vodka, Lemon Sorbet, Pineapple, Prosecco Float *Also available as a Mocktail $11*
serverNotes:
💙 📖 ABOUT: Fun, fruity Instagram-worthy cocktail! Blueberry vodka, lemon sorbet, pineapple with Prosecco float. Light, refreshing & celebration-ready! Also available as Mocktail ($10).

🍸 PROFILE: Berry-Tropical Fusion | Blueberry vodka, lemon sorbet, pineapple & Prosecco float | Beautiful layered effect | Elegant bubbles on top | Sweet, fun & not too strong!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Brunch dishes, fruit desserts, light salads, appetizers.

💡 SERVING TIP: Serve in tall glass with layers. The sorbet keeps it cold while creating visual appeal! Perfect for celebrations or warm weather. Crowd-pleasing & approachable!

name: Mango Inferno
description: Ghost Tequila, Mango, Jalapeño, Pineapple, Lime
serverNotes:
🔥 📖 ABOUT: Bold spicy-sweet cocktail featuring [Ghost Tequila](https://ghosttequila.com/)—smooth 100% Blue Weber agave from Jalisco, Mexico. For spice lovers!

🍸 PROFILE: Tropical Heat | Ghost tequila, fresh mango, jalapeño, pineapple & lime | Sweet fire perfectly balanced | Real jalapeño kick! | Mango & pineapple cool the heat!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Mexican dishes, spicy appetizers, wings, bold flavors.

💡 SERVING TIP: Ask guests about spice tolerance first! Serve in rocks glass with lime. Perfect for adventurous drinkers & spicy food lovers. The name captures the sweet fire! Popular choice for tequila enthusiasts.

name: Espresso Martini
description: Vanilla Vodka, Bepi Tossolini Espresso Liqueur, House-Brewed Espresso, Splash of Cream
serverNotes:
☕ ABOUT: Classic espresso martini featuring [Bepi Tossolini Espresso Liqueur](https://www.bepitossolini.it/) from Italy + house-brewed fresh espresso. Both dessert & pick-me-up! ⚠️ Contains caffeine.

🍸 PROFILE: Rich & Caffeinated | Vanilla vodka, Bepi Tossolini liqueur, fresh espresso & splash of cream | Beautiful foam on top | Authentic coffee flavor—not artificial! | 3 coffee bean garnish!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Tiramisu, chocolate desserts, cannoli, Italian sweets.

💡 SERVING TIP: Shake vigorously for foam! Serve in martini glass. Perfect after-dinner for coffee lovers who want elegant finish. Popular for late dinners or energy with elegance! Mention caffeine to guests.

name: Mi Casa, Su Casa
description: Bribon Reposado, Fresh Lime Juice, Agave Nectar, Shiraz Float, brûléed Lime
serverNotes:
🏠 📖 ABOUT: Creative margarita featuring [Bribon Reposado](https://bribontequila.com/) tequila (oak-aged 100% agave from Jalisco). Means 'my house, your house'—welcoming & shareable!

🍸 PROFILE: Margarita Reimagined | Bribon reposado, fresh lime, agave nectar & Shiraz wine float | Beautiful ombre effect! | Oak character from reposado | Brûléed lime adds caramelized wow!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Mexican dishes, grilled meats, spicy appetizers, bold flavors.

💡 SERVING TIP: Serve in rocks glass. The red wine float adds depth & visual drama! Great conversation starter. Perfect for tequila lovers seeking innovation beyond standard margaritas. Popular with margarita fans!

name: The VIA Mai Tai
description: Privateer Rum, Gosling's Dark Rum, Amaretto, Orgeat Syrup, Fresh Lime, Pineapple Juice and Amarena Cherry *ALLERGY: This drink recipe contains Almonds*
serverNotes: Via's twist on the classic Mai Tai with Privateer Rum, Gosling's Dark Rum, amaretto, orgeat syrup, fresh lime, pineapple juice, and Amarena cherry. Tropical, nutty, and complex. Dual rums provide depth - Privateer for brightness, Gosling's for richness. Amaretto adds almond sweetness and Italian character. Orgeat syrup (almond-based) brings authentic tiki flavor. Tropical flavors with sophisticated depth. IMPORTANT: Contains almonds—always mention allergen. Perfect for tiki cocktail lovers. Pairs wonderfully with tropical dishes, spicy food, and island-inspired cuisine. Beautiful presentation with cherry garnish. Popular celebration choice.

name: Plane Crash
description: Jefferson's Small Batch Bourbon Infused with Smoked Honey, Aperol, Amaro dell'Etna and Fresh Lemon
serverNotes: Bold, sophisticated signature cocktail inspired by the Paper Plane. Jefferson's bourbon infused with smoked honey, Aperol, Amaro dell'Etna, and fresh lemon. Complex, balanced, and conversation-worthy. The smoked honey adds depth and intrigue. Sicilian Amaro dell'Etna brings volcanic mineral character. Aperol provides bitter-orange brightness. Perfect for bourbon and amaro enthusiasts. For guests who appreciate craft cocktails with layers of flavor. Pairs excellently with charcuterie, grilled meats, Italian appetizers, and bold flavors. The name references the classic Paper Plane cocktail. Popular choice for cocktail connoisseurs.

name: Raspberry Mojito
description: Our classic made with Privateer Rum from Ipswich, MA *Also available as a Mocktail $11*
serverNotes: Via's signature take on the classic mojito with Privateer rum from Ipswich MA, fresh raspberries, mint, lime, and soda. Refreshing, fruity, and perfectly balanced. Made with local Massachusetts rum for New England pride. Fresh mint muddled for authentic mojito character. Raspberries add beautiful color and fruity sweetness. Also available as a Mocktail for $10. Perfect for warm weather, celebrations, or guests who love classic cocktails with a twist. Pairs wonderfully with salads, seafood, light dishes, and Cuban-inspired cuisine. Crowd-pleasing favorite.

name: Banana Bread Old Fashioned
description: Sazerac, house made banana brown sugar syrup, black walnut & Angostura bitters.
serverNotes:
🍌 ABOUT: Sazerac Rye stirred with house made banana brown sugar syrup, black walnut and Angostura bitters.

🥃 PROFILE: Rich & spirit-forward | Caramelized banana, brown sugar, toasted walnut and rye spice

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Short Rib, Berkshire Pork Chop, Filet Mignon, desserts.

💡 SERVING TIP: Black walnut bitters are a nut flavoring; mention it for nut-allergy questions.

name: Campfire Old Fashioned
description: Mad River Maple Bourbon, demerara, chocolate & black walnut bitters, toasted marshmallow.
serverNotes:
🔥 ABOUT: Mad River Maple Bourbon with demerara, chocolate and black walnut bitters, finished with a toasted marshmallow.

🥃 PROFILE: S'mores in a glass | Maple, cocoa, toasted sugar and oak

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Filet Mignon, Surf & Turf, Short Rib, chocolate desserts.

💡 SERVING TIP: Black walnut bitters are a nut flavoring; mention it for nut-allergy questions.

name: Añejo Old Fashioned
description: Alma De Jaguar Añejo, agave, rye, orange & chocolate mole bitters, smoke.
serverNotes:
🥃 ABOUT: Alma De Jaguar Añejo tequila with agave, a touch of rye, orange and chocolate mole bitters, finished with smoke.

🥃 PROFILE: Smoky & spirit-forward | Aged agave, oak, orange peel and cocoa-chili spice

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Filet Mignon, Grilled Veal Chop, Short Rib, Berkshire Pork Chop.

💡 SERVING TIP: The premium Old Fashioned on the list. Great for whiskey drinkers curious about aged tequila.
